name: AURAGENT Isolation Fabric
scope: process isolation contract with fail-closed unsupported backend
security_invariants: filesystem bind mounts require explicit allowed host roots
external egress is denied unless a managed egress boundary exists
host root and container root mounts are forbidden
resource quotas are bounded by a server ceiling
images are never auto-pulled by the backend
shell execution is disabled by default
secrets are not accepted through raw isolation environment variables
build_policy: Complete implementation first; comprehensive integration verification is deferred to final AURAGENT verification.
